title: Area formula (2.4)-(2.5) for countably n-rectifiable sets
statement: For n, ℓ, ℓ₁ ∈ ℕ, M ⊆ ℝ^{n+ℓ} Hⁿ-measurable and countably n-rectifiable, θ a positive locally integrable weight on M, U ⊇ M open and f : ℝ^{n+ℓ} → ℝ^{n+ℓ₁} locally Lipschitz on U, with T_xM := approxTangentPlane n M θ x and J^M_f(x) := areaJacobian (T_xM) f x = normDet of the tangential differential: (a) for Hⁿ-a.e. x ∈ M there are P and a continuous linear L : P → ℝ^{n+ℓ₁} with HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M θ x P and HasTangentialDifferentialAt P f x L; (b) for every Hⁿ-measurable A ⊆ M, ∫_A J^M_f dHⁿ = ∫_{ℝ^{n+ℓ₁}} #(A ∩ f⁻¹{y}) dHⁿ(y) (# = encard); (c) for every Hⁿ⌞M-measurable h : ℝ^{n+ℓ} → [0, ∞], ∫_M h·J^M_f dHⁿ = ∫_{ℝ^{n+ℓ₁}} Σ_{x ∈ M ∩ f⁻¹{y}} h(x) dHⁿ(y). (This is the contract's AreaFormula; outer integrals over the target, correcting the printed ℝ^{n+ℓ}.)
